columns.name: R_hinvMpc
columns.note: clustercentric physical radius, fiducial cosmology Om=0.3 h=0.7

columns.name: g_plus
columns.note: stacked tangential REDUCED shear g_+ = gamma/(1-kappa), lensing-weighted over the 313 eFEDS systems with HSC S19A coverage

columns.name: used_fiducial
columns.note: 1 if the bin is used in the paper's fiducial lensing model (R > 0.5 h^-1 Mpc)

extraction: exact vector-coordinate recovery from the PDF content stream; NOT pixel digitisation.  Axis transform fitted on four labelled major ticks per axis, log-linear residual < 1e-6 dex.  Gates: error bars symmetric in linear g to <5e-3; bin spacing matches the paper's declared ten log bins over 0.2-3.5 h^-1 Mpc.
caveat: This is ONE stacked profile over the whole sample.  It is not per-cluster shear and carries no within-sample potential-depth leverage on its own.
